newsitem.title: UK: Harry Ramsden's unwraps expansion plans.
newsitem.headline: Harry Ramsden's unwraps expansion plans.

text.p: British fish and chip chain Harry Ramsden's Plc on Wednesday unwrapped plans to open a batch of new restaurants that could lure dozens of Britons off the dole.
The company, which recruits a minimum of 20 percent long-term unemployed people at every new location, said it planned to open 10 new restaurants, creating 1,000 new jobs by next summer.
The chain, started by namesake Harry Ramsden in 1928, currently has 19 restaurants, including one in Australia and another in Hong Kong.
Locations for the new branches range from Aberdeen, Scotland, to Southampton, England, and also include overseas openings in Saudi Arabia and Singapore.
In addition, the chain said it was targeting three more sites in Britain for expansion in the next 12 months.
